text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kashiwa Kinen. Last year, Hokko
Tarumae
won this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, inside the paddock, there is
no sign of
the previous year's champion.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... I really wanted to run against
her
today, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I guess she's still far from being in peak
condition.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She's returned more or less to her daily
routine
after Dubai, but racing is still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it seems Tarumae is dealing with
some kind of
mild tummy pain.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's not just being tired from traveling
overseas. It
seems she brought home
some sort of stomach
bug.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see. My feng shui readings did predict
mild
health issues.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae must be feeling down. I'll have
to...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up, Rickey! You're not going to
make
Tarumae any happier with you
looking so glum.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You won't help the fans expecting to see
an
exciting race either.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. You might be concerned right
now, but
try to take a step back and see
the bigger
picture.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Someday, you'll look back on this time
fondly.
The world is funny like that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"See the bigger picture," huh... You're
right,
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Me acting depressed isn't going to cheer
anyone
up! Besides...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae isn't my only strong rival. You
are too,
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're not wrong. I've run a lot more
races than
you after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My hustle will be so overwhelming, you
won't
have the chance to worry about
Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll run my best too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae may be absent, but
Copano
Rickey still has a strong rival in
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose, both for my own
sake and
for Tarumae's. And there's
another reason on top
of that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Today's the day!
